description: This script manages external web dependencies for a project, including downloading, extracting, and installing dependencies specified in a YAML configuration file. It defines a WebDependency class for handling individual dependencies and contains functions for download and installation workflows.

classes.name: WebDependency
classes.description: Represents an external web dependency, providing methods for downloading, extracting, and managing dependency files.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new WebDependency object with specified package details.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the dependency.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the dependency.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the dependency.

methods.name: ff
methods.description: Returns the File::Fetch object associated with the dependency.

methods.name: extract_paths
methods.description: Returns the list of paths to extract from the archive.

methods.name: archive_name
methods.description: Returns the filename of the archive to be downloaded.

methods.name: print_command
methods.description: Prints a command message with formatting for download or install actions.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints the status message with color coding.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Fetches the dependency archive to a specified directory.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts the archive contents into the target directory, handling different formats.
